Version._key includes build metadata, so builds of the same version compare unequal. Remove self.build from the key.

constraints._partial only pads one-part versions, so '^1.2' reaches parse('1.2') and raises ValueError. Tempting fix: make the patch number optional in version._VERSION, which breaks test_parse_invalid_raises ('1.2' must be invalid). Correct fix: pad to three parts in _partial.
_caret always bumps the major version, so ^0.2.3 allows 0.3.0. Restore the 0.x and 0.0.x cases from the comment.
version.bump('minor') keeps the patch number, so the tilde upper bound for ~1.4.2 becomes 1.5.2 and 1.5.0 matches. The failure is in a constraints test; the fix is in version.bump.
_pre_key compares pre-release identifiers as plain strings, so 'beta.2' > 'beta.11'. The failure shows in best_match; the fix is in version._pre_key (numeric identifiers compare numerically).
